custom_nsfw_prompt.description: Optional author-managed adult style prompt. Applied only to adult turns in enabled groups and limited to supported content and style.

adult_classifier_enabled.description: Use the Flash model to classify unmatched direct messages in enabled groups.

adult_classifier_provider_id.description: AstrBot provider ID used for adult-intent classification.

adult_classifier_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time allowed for one adult-intent classification.

adult_classifier_min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence required to activate the adult prompt.

adult_classifier_cache_ttl_seconds.description: Classification cache lifetime for repeated identical messages.

adult_classifier_cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of hashed adult-classification cache entries.
